title: RealAddr for Agents
tagline: A realistic rental address that enables contract execution solely through autonomous AI agents
description:
Currently, 57% of all web requests originate from bots and AI agents—humans are now the minority. To help AI agents operate offline as well as online, we have built a service that leases physical addresses to them. Contracts can be executed autonomously by AI agents using x402 payments. However, due to legal requirements, mail forwarding is permitted only for requests verified through human authentication via World ID.

We also support secure x402 billing powered by Intercepta, as well as business support that links ENS domains to physical addresses using ENSv2. Currently, addresses across 11 locations in Japan are available for use.
how_its_made:
Monetization via x402; Intercepta; curvegrid (MultiBaas)
Human verification using World ID
Low-cost linking and sale of ENS names and addresses using the ENSv2 hierarchical registry
GCP (Cloud Run, Firestore, Google Cloud Storage, Google Auth)
GitHub Actions; TypeScript
Support for Ethereum Sepolia and Base Sepolia via MultiBaas
auto_summary: A TypeScript monorepo for leasing physical mailing addresses to agents, with human approval checks, ENS-linked names, and onchain lease records.
